entries.title: Judges 12:1
segments:
Went northward; towards Mizpeh, on the east side of Jordan, where Jephthah lived. 
 
Persons who have refused to engage in great and difficult services themselves, often most bitterly envy those who have successfully performed them.

entries.title: Judges 12:2
segments: Ye delivered me not; did not attempt it.

entries.title: Judges 12:3
segments:
Put my life in my hands; took on myself the work and danger of attempting to obtain deliverance. 
 
Men are sometimes called, instead of depending on others, to take themselves the responsibility, meet the dangers, and perform the labors of great and trying emergencies.  In such cases they should not shrink, but in dependence on God go forward in duty, and leave the result to him.

entries.title: Judges 12:4
segments: Fugitives of Ephraim; the Gileadites belonged to the tribe of Manasseh.

The Ephraimites reproach them as a remnant who had fled before themselves across the Jordan, and who were unworthy to be ranked with their brethren of Ephraim and Manasseh. 
 
Family contentions are most bitter and disastrous.  The beginning of them should be most carefully avoided, for when once begun no one can tell where they will end.

entries.title: Judges 12:6
segments: Forty and two thousand; supposed by many to mean two thousand and forty, as the Ephraimites when numbered amounted only to thirty-two thousand five hundred.

But this reason cannot be regarded as conclusive, since the numbering referred to took place three hundred years before. 
 
Those who wickedly begin a quarrel, would often be struck with horror should they foresee all its consequences.

entries.title: Judges 12:7
segments: As death is to all persons near, and after death is the judgment, the great object of all should be so to live as to be fitted, through grace, to give up their account with joy, and enter into that rest which remains for the people of God.

entries.title: Judges 12:10
segments: Bethlehem; there were two places of this name, one in Zebulun, and one in Judah where our Saviour was born.

entries.title: Judges 12:13
segments: A Pirathonite; so called from Pirathon the place where he lived.

entries.title: Judges 12:14
segments: Nephews; in the original, sons' sons, or grandsons.

entries.title: Judges 12:15
segments: Mount of the Amalekites; supposed to be a place in Ephraim called by that name.
